description: Defines a Salary Data Transfer Object (DTO) class used for representing and normalizing employee salary data within the OrangeHRM system. The class includes methods to convert salary data to an array format and to map data fields from salary entities.

classes.name: Salary
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) for employee salary information, capable of normalizing and converting salary data into array format, utilizing traits and external service layers for data retrieval.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the Salary DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Fetches employee salary data and normalizes it into an array based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping from data fields to getter methods for retrieving corresponding data from salary entities.
